notes.title: Prologue
notes.content:
Hello and welcome, my dear Bonk (Actually its Wolf, but in Russian that is Волк, that should be [volk], but who cares). We are glad to see you here. 
The hardest part of every beggining is actualy to start. as Bonk wisdom tells, so here we are.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44051377/6b09779ed4ece6f3786b2bdd8b261b254ea7c937.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44051377/146a755370094512e565b169bcb87c7643a7720b.jpg[/img][/url]
Main plan of utilizing news here is to share summary of a devlog, upadets and news from the Enchanted Forest. as well as to stay in touch with everyone interested of a game.

Well, that all for now, soon there will be some news about current state and whats happening in overal, so stay tuned,

If you'd like to hear more, make sure to subcribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcOMygoVMYOPHHbJOiqqxFQ]Youtube channel[/url] and join [url=https://discord.gg/JWeV9QNPU9]Discord[/url].
